title: Futex Linux compatibility handoff
current_state: Classic non-PI futex, PI lock/requeue, robust-list, futex2 32-bit subset, and rt_mutex-shaped PI priority-tree/task-pi_waiters implementation are present in the branch.
PI-condvar guest evidence is now a judged branch-local OSComp group: make oscomp-rv64-pthread-pi-condvar produces [pthread-pi-condvar] 1/1.
LTP futex discovery has a reusable target: make oscomp-rv64-ltp-futex builds a slim 17-case futex/robust image and boots it under QEMU.

Current LTP futex discovery reaches selected cases; most return TBROK on missing /proc/meminfo, while set_robust_list01 exits 0. This is a procfs coverage blocker before LTP can isolate futex semantics.
Full SCHED_DEADLINE is not closed by this branch; it remains scheduler EDF/admission-control work and is not a futex merge blocker.

changed_files.reason: Explicit waiter rows, classic futex behavior, PI lock state, priority-ordered PI waiter trees, requeue, timeout/cancel cleanup, robust futex handling, and tests.
Task-level pi_waiters, effective priority computation, runnable selection over boosted tasks, and PI waiter API support.
Adapter seam for futex-owned priority donation and effective-priority lookup without reversing dependency direction.
Linux futex syscall dispatch for classic, PI, waitv, futex2, timeout, and requeue paths.
Focused syscall ABI and PI scheduling regression coverage.
OSComp group selection and pthread-pi-condvar branch-local group routing.
Static RV64 musl pthread PI-condvar helper, runner, and judge script.
Python 3.9 compatibility, output directory creation, ext4 inode mode preservation, musl lib inclusion for LTP, and futex subset support.
Reusable PI-condvar and LTP futex RV64 evidence targets.
Plans, research, status, and this handoff for futex Linux-compat stabilization.

verification.notes: 48 futex dispatch tests passed in the focused stabilization run.
Produced [pthread-pi-condvar] 1/1, userspace exit 0, and no decoded trap lines.
Discovery run reached all 17 selected cases; most returned TBROK on missing /proc/meminfo, set_robust_list01 exited 0, userspace exited 0, and fault-decode found no trap lines.
